title: Abelian hypercover totals preserve colimits
statement: Let U be a simplicial object over a pro-etale X-object W, with every U_p affine and weakly contractible in the sense of surjective evaluation of set-sheaf epimorphisms. The abelian hypercover total functor [def-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-hypercover-total] preserves all colimits of the permitted size [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Tags 09A2 and 0946; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Constructible sheaves, Lemma 5.3(1)

proof.text: Degree-p section evaluation preserves colimits by exact affine weakly contractible abelian evaluation.

Alternating coface complexes preserve colimits degreewise. Extension by zero preserves colimits: evaluate at an image degree using the extension isomorphism, or use zero off the image. Flipping bicomplexes preserves colimits by double evaluation.

For an arbitrary colimit cocone of bicomplexes, construct the total cocone desc degreewise by totalDesc and the colimits of the individual terms. The total inclusions verify the chain relation and cocone identities. Uniqueness follows by total.hom_ext and the degreewise colimit universal properties. Compose these preservation results.

lean.statement:
theorem abelianHypercoverTotal_preservesColimits
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W : X.ProEt) (U : SimplicialObject (Over W))
    (haff : ∀ n : ℕ, IsAffine (U _⦋n⦌).left.left)
    (hweak : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F G : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G),
      Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op (U _⦋n⦌).left))) :
    PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (abelianHypercoverTotal X W U)
